title: François Patriat, Former Socialist Minister and Early Macron Loyalist, Dies at 83
detail: François Patriat, a former Socialist minister who became one of Emmanuel Macron's earliest and most prominent supporters, died at the age of 83. Patriat was a senator and longtime figure in French left-wing politics who crossed the political divide to back Macron's La République En Marche movement from its founding.

title: France and Germany Formally Condemn Israeli Minister Ben Gvir's Calls for Killings in Gaza
detail: France and Germany issued a formal joint condemnation of Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir following his public calls for killings in Gaza. The two European powers described the statements as unacceptable, reflecting growing European diplomatic pressure over the conduct of Israeli officials amid the ongoing conflict.
